title: Seoul Economic Daily highlights Burford's focus on semiconductor patent disputes
summary: Seoul Economic Daily highlights Burford's focus on semiconductor patent disputes. Learn more.
body_markdown:
In an interview with *Seoul Economic Daily* ,[Christopher Freeman](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-freeman/) and[Elizabeth Shin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/elizabeth-shin/) discuss the rise in semiconductor patent litigation amid growing demand for AI-driven memory technology. Freeman notes that “memory patent disputes are already on the rise” and could increase further as chip shipments surge and technology advances.


Read the full article[here](https://www.sedaily.com/article/20114218) .
